title: Altermagnetism: reading spin in crystals with compensated magnetization
summary: Even when atomic magnetic moments cancel, electron spin bands can split in a direction-dependent way. How that directionality produces spin-polarized current also depends on magnetic order, domains and contacts. Starting from spin injection in Mn₅Si₃ at 100 K, this review follows electronic and magnon observations and the RuO₂ debate to examine how symmetry predictions can be tested in real materials and devices.
